'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Brian Herold LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Carly Rae Cyrus
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
